about: Firmware files Station Mini Root has verified on real Station Mini 1 (YNDX-0004) units. The image builder patches OTA only when the updater it finds is listed here; anything else stops the build before flashing. Add an entry only after checking the binary on a device.

updater_switcher.note: First verified switcher: starts legacy --updatesd or the dedicated updater with --updater_gateway.
Firmware 1.305.4.16.3237824040.20250721: identical to the first switcher except its 20-byte GNU Build ID.

noupdate_script.text:
#!/bin/sh
# disabled by noupdate
logger -t noupdate "OTA apply blocked" 2>/dev/null
exit 0
noupdate_script.note: Inert device_ota_update.sh left by the earlier noupdate patch; recognized so such units can be rooted.
